100NoteExtended validation: 8 isolated-core workloads, two full reads each m18–m33. Joint affine sensor fits across these plus low, nominal, A/B and near-cap workloads favor global actual/model boundary conductance 0.828 (~20.8% model error). T_core2 needs +3.95% observed rise gain (4.33% at x1.2 boundary R) with -0.1 C intercept, beyond 3% slope sheet. Core5 fitted slope ~3.35% is marginal and compatible with normal sheet plus model fidelity. Conclude core2 gain fault roughly +5%.

191Revive h10Comparing transient shapes across every core reveals core0 and its neighbor core2 heat earlier than the shared late-time cooling behavior predicts. Core0 silicon capacitance is an outlier in the initial netlist; a localized capacitance error can affect its neighbor without creating a steady sensor fault.
192Propose h12The model overstates silicon thermal capacitance at core0, in addition to overestimating global boundary conductance by about 25%; core2's apparent gain is normal calibration plus transient coupling, not an instrument fault.
